summary: Session 2026-11-02 (pre-open). Held all cash. Friday close: SPY -1.77%, QQQ -3.47%, XLK -4.9%, INTC -28.6%, RDDT -29.2% (Q3 beat but weak Q4 guide, Google AI cutting US traffic, login-wall test). Premarket futures bouncing (NQ +0.7%, ES +0.3%). Midterm elections Nov 3, jobs report later this week, Brent ~$110. No clean catalyst edge: shorting after huge gaps or buying falling knives has poor risk/reward before stabilisation. Next session: see whether the bounce holds. Candidates for rebound longs once they confirm are FTNT (136), NOW (105), GOOGL (280) and INTC (65.8). RDDT is a possible short if a bounce fades. Look for fresh earnings catalysts in non-tech sectors, since staples and energy led on Friday. Don't stay in cash indefinitely: three cash sessions so far.
